simple.meaning: properly, to prostrate ; hence, to break down, either (literally) by violence, or (figuratively) by confusion and fear
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חָתַת (H2865) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.

definitions.short: properly, to prostrate ; hence, to break down, either (literally) by violence, or (figuratively) by confusion and fear
definitions.usage: abolish, affright, be (make) afraid, amaze, beat down, discourage, (cause to) dismay, go down, scare, terrify.
definitions.full: H2865. chathath [ חָתַת ] verb be shattered, dismayed (Assyrian —attu , terror , Dl HWB 296 ; Talmud חִתִּית id. ; Ethiopic is scrutari, examinare , see Di Lex, 105 ) — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular חַת Jer 50:2-3 ;feminine singular חַ֫תָּה 14:4 2 t., וָחָ֑תָּה 48:1 ; 3 plural חַ֫תּוּ Isa 37:27 4 t., וְחַתּ֫וּ consecutive 20:5 2 t., וָחָ֑תּוּ consecutive Jer 50:36 ; Imperfect (Kö i. 366 ) יֵחַת Isa 7:8 ; 30:31 , יֵחַ֑ת Job 39:22 , יֵחָ֑ת Isa 31:4 , אֵחַ֫תָּה Jer 17:18 , יֵחַ֫תּוּ 1Sam 2:10 3 t. — On יֵּחַ֑תּוּ Job 21:13 see נָחַת ; — תֵּחָ֑תּוּ Josh 10:25 2 t., etc.; Imperative וָחֹ֫תּוּ Isa 8:9 (3 t. in verse); — 1 be shattered, broken , figurative of nations under divine judgment Isa 7:8 ; 30:31 ; so probably also 8:9 (3 t. in verse) (but strike out in v a ), and perhaps (of ׳י 's foes in General) 1Sam 2:10 (song; — others render dismayed in all except Isa 7:8 ); figurative of ׳י s righteousness 51:6 (= be abolished, annihilated); literally of bows Jer 51:56 , according to Gie's reading חַתָּה , see Pi`el 2. be dismayed , usually a. absolute: || יָרֵא Deut 1:21 ; 31:8 ; Josh 8:1 ; 10:25 (all D), 1Sam 17:11 ; Jer 23:4 ; 30:10 ; 46:27 ; Ezek 2:6 ; 3:9 ; 1Chr 22:13 ; 28:20 ; 2Chr 20:15 , 17 ; 32:7 ; || בּוֺשׁ Isa 20:5 ; 37:27 = 2Kin 19:26 ; Jer 8:9 ; 17:18 (twice in verse); 48:1 , 20 , 39 ; 50:2 (twice in verse) (others assign. 48:20 , 39 ; 50:2 (twice in verse) to 1 ); figurative of the ground הָאֲדָמָה , dismayed for lack of rain Jer 14:4 read probably with Duhm (after ᵐ5 ) Co Dr ׳וְעֹבְדֵ חַתּוּ ; (|| בּוֺשׁ of the husband-men); no || 50:36 ; Obadiah 9; Job 39:22 . b. be dismayed at, by reason of , followed by מִן Isa 31:4 , 9 ; 51:7 (|| יָרֵא ) Jer 1:17 ; 10:2 (twice in verse). Niph`al Perfect only 3 masculine singular נִחַת שְׁמִי וּמִמְּנֵי Mal 2:5 and at my name he is put in awe (|| יָרֵא ). Pi`el Perfect dismay, scare , 2 masculine singular suffix בַחֲלֹמוֺת וְחִתַּתַּ֫נִי (Kö i. 372 ) consecutive Job 7:14 and thou scarest me with dreams (|| בִּעֵת ); 3 feminine singular חִתְּתָה Jer 51:56 (of bows) is intransitive [inchoate Ew § 120, 2 d ], Gf and others, be shattered , but text probably erroneous. Gie חַתָּה (see Qal 1 ). Hiph`il Perfect 2masculine singular הַחִתֹּתָ Isa 9:3 ; 1 singular וְהַחְתַּתִּ֫י Jer 49:37 (Kö i. 372 ); Imperfect 3masculine singular suffix יְחִתֵּנִי Job 31:34 , suffix 3feminine plural יְחִיתַ֑ן Hab 2:17 (Kö i. 374 ; but ᵑ6 ᵑ7 ᵐ5 Ew Ol Sta We יְחִתֶּ֑ךָ ); 1 singular suffix אֲחִתְּךָ Jer 1:17 (followed by לפניהם ) — 1 shutter with accusative Isa 9:3 . 2. a. cause to be dismayed Jer 49:37 followed by לִפְנֵי . b. dismay, terrify , followed by suffix Job 31:34 ; Hab 2:17 .
